self-service for Collections, scores and strategies for Collections, WhatsApp Calling, New Zealand as a region, out-of-credit alerts, and several ticket and import fixes.

Debtor self-service: a debtor opens their own page from the link in their payment SMS. They can pay, see their account after a one-time code, pick a payment plan within the creditor's limits, or give notice of a dispute or debt review. Creditors set the limits, and the requests show under Settlements, in Debtor requests, and on the account panel.

Scores and strategies: every account gets a daily pay score and contact score. A campaign can dial the most money first. Strategies compare arms against a champion, the Strategy results report shows how each arm did, and Segment results can be grouped by pay band. The Collections hub has a Strategies tab.

WhatsApp Calling: a WhatsApp number can take inbound calls over Meta's calling service. A card on the number page switches it on, the desk shows a WhatsApp label on the ringing card and the live call, and usage counts the call minutes. It needs the WhatsApp Calling plan feature.

New Zealand: tenants, storage and AI providers can be placed in New Zealand, chosen in the region lists. Recordings that were erased are expired, and offsite backups can go to Azure.

Chat AI: a hand-over to a named agent reserves that agent, and otherwise says a colleague will help. When tickets open on every channel, the AI is told the ticket number as an instruction, not as customer text.

Ticket imports: an email thread's messages are looked for in the mailbox it came to, up to 180 days before its ticket, and an import says why emails were not found. An email already on another ticket is linked to this one too.

Out of credit: when WhatsApp, SMS Portal, Clickatell, MTN or an SMPP operator refuses a send for lack of credit, one out-of-credit alert goes out and journeys and broadcasts on that account pause. The next successful send clears it.

Staging: the test runner is capped in memory, and the pages deploy and prune scripts are the one way to publish staging pages.

Fixes: flow, queue and AI-provider lists keep the saved choice when they load late, the saved "resolved" wording says the 2-day reopen window, a call standby's telephony worker is no longer reported as a stopped service, and a sign-in page left open too long signs in once more instead of showing an error."}
